review_method: view_image at original detail for native_detail_25 through native_detail_33; all fourteen 1:1 native landmark crops checked per sample, with selected original source images inspected for uncertain occlusions.

samples.review_note: INDIAN WELLS floor text, purple hard court and green surround. The ball and far/near player limbs in the service-center patches stay beside the intersections.
